title: MAINTENANCE ANNEX
description: Verify stored records, admit verified records to the queue, then write a separate replay copy.

prerequisites.missingEvidence: Restore SPOOL-02 at the recovery console first.
Obtain the verified R07-SPOOL-02 manifest from Signal Hunter or Relay Trader.

choices.result: Reconstruct readable dispatch in a separate copy and keep the sealed originals.
Write readable dispatch over the originals.
choices.feedback: REPLACE would overwrite the sealed originals and lose their custody record.

choices.result: Keep the sealed originals and leave the working spool empty.
choices.feedback: RESET leaves an empty spool. The manifest requires a readable replay.

choices.result: Clear the working spool and the sealed originals.
choices.feedback: RESET leaves no readable replay, and REPLACE destroys the original custody record.

copy.missingFragments: Open Retained source fragments and review each module boundary before comparing the recipe.
copy.missingComparison: COMPARE the retained fragments and recipe with the verified manifest first.
copy.mismatch: Reconstruction blocked. The retained modules, recipe, or custody evidence disagree with the signed record.
copy.chooseMode: Select a compatibility choice or type RECONSTRUCT <operation> / <evidence mode>.
copy.comparisonHeading: RETAINED MODULES CHECKED AGAINST THE MANIFEST
copy.saveRefused: LOCAL SAVE UNAVAILABLE. Replay was not committed. Select the compatible mode again to retry.
